en: The image is an old illustrated postcard with a faded, sepia-toned drawing of the Pyramids of Giza. In the foreground, there are palm trees, a camel, and people, giving a typical orientalist depiction of Egypt. The artwork is surrounded by delicate floral designs, and on the top right, there is text written in cursive. The upper right also has the word 'SOUVENIR' in vintage script. There are postal markings and a handwritten message in purple ink.
